title: The Naito--Okuda--Ouyang Biconcave Red Blood Cell Profile as a Finite-Energy Unbranched Weak Immersion with Point-Force Residues
summary: The axisymmetric profile \(\sinψ(ρ)=c_0ρ\log(ρ/ρ_B)\) introduced by Naito, Okuda, and Ouyang is an exact solution of the unconstrained Helfrich shape equation for every \(ρ>0\), but its mean curvature diverges logarithmically at the dimple center. A covariant local analysis shows that in Cartesian graph coordinates the immersion is nondegenerate and belongs to \(W^{2,p}\) for every finite \(p\); it is \(C^{1,α}\) for every \(α<1\), but neither \(C^{1,1}\) nor \(C^2\).
